pages.description: Make only the scientifically necessary correction to the supplied figure. Remove the Fusion box and every arrow that merges MOMENT with XGBoost. Keep the blue operational path: aligned 35-by-33 well-log window, window statistics and local gradients, XGBoost multi-softprob trees, nine logits, softmax, fixed nine-class probability vector, Depth/TWT class sequence. Keep the orange MOMENT path as a separate controlled research ablation: interpolate the same window from 33 to 512 samples, patch embedding, MOMENT transformer encoder, then two matched heads labelled Pretrained and Random init. Both orange heads terminate only at a gray Pretraining-effect comparator with placeholders Delta Macro-F1, Delta mIoU, and Delta NLL; this comparator must not connect to the operational class sequence. Preserve the bottom LOGO4 mother-well split, class weighting, multi-seed training, and fixed-nine metrics. Preserve every other module and the original compact professional geometry. Ensure no content is cropped at any edge.
